title: Tensor presheaf induction and its sheafified Frobenius adjunction
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] on the small coherent site of profinite sets [def-weil-size-convention]. For a profinite group $J$, let $\mathcal A_J(A)$ denote internal $A$-modules with $A$-linear condensed $J$-action [def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. Let $P$ be a profinite group and $H$ a closed subgroup. For each profinite test set $S$ put $P_S=C(S,P)$ and $H_S=C(S,H)$. The group algebra $A(S)[P_S]$ consists of finite formal sums with multiplication $[p][p']=[pp']$. For $M\in\mathcal A_H(A)$ put $B_M(S)=A(S)[P_S]\otimes_{A(S)[H_S]}M(S)$.

The formulas $[p]\otimes m\mapsto[p\circ t]\otimes t^*m$ for $t:T\to S$ make $B_M$ an $A$-module presheaf, and $g([p]\otimes m)=[gp]\otimes m$ gives a natural $P$-action. Module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] induces this action on $L(M)=B_M^\#$ and makes $L:\mathcal A_H(A)\to\mathcal A_P(A)$ an additive functor whose map on a morphism $u$ is induced by $[p]\otimes m\mapsto[p]\otimes u(m)$.

Write $\eta_M:B_M\to B_M^\#$ for the sheafification unit, and let $\operatorname{Res}_H^P$ restrict the action through $H\hookrightarrow P$. For all $M\in\mathcal A_H(A)$ and $N\in\mathcal A_P(A)$ there are inverse bijections, natural in both variables,
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A_P(A)}(L(M),N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A_H(A)}(M,\operatorname{Res}_H^P N).$$
The forward bijection sends $F$ to $m\mapsto F(\eta_M([1]\otimes m))$. Its inverse sends $f$ to the unique sheafified extension of $[p]\otimes m\mapsto p\cdot f(m)$. No section of a coset projection is assumed.

proof.text: Take the explicit tensor presheaf B, then sheafification data D. The section maps from the concrete quotient are determined by the pure tensors. Apply injectivity of the ordinary module-sheafification Hom equivalence and cancel the comparison to conclude that maps out of L(M) are determined by every sheafified tensor.

The additive relation in the quotient gives eta([p] tensor (m+n))=eta([p] tensor m)+eta([p] tensor n). Apply the map formula and generator extensionality to prove that L preserves addition of morphisms.

Define Phi(F) by composing identityTensor with Res(F). For each f choose an extension supplied by the existence-only extension lemma. Phi(extension(f))=f since 1 acts identically. Conversely the chosen extension of Phi(F) agrees with F on pure tensors by P-equivariance and the induced-action formula, hence equals F by generator extensionality.

For u:Mprime to M, extensions of u followed by f agree on tensors with L(u) followed by the extension of f; generator extensionality gives naturality on the left. Naturality on the right is associativity of composition with identityTensor. Use Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv. Its Hom equivalence is the constructed equivalence, so the forward formula follows from identityTensor_apply. The inverse characterization follows from the extension formula and generator extensionality.
